topic: Day 104 — reel — You can love your family and still question what they taught you
text:
You can keep
the [relationship]
and update the
inheritance.
caption:
Loving people doesn't require keeping every belief they handed you. Loyalty to a person and loyalty to their conclusions are different debts.

Follow for one of these a day.
